Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting victim data and demanding ransom payment
Psychological manipulation via holiday-themed ransom notes
Offering discounts to entice ransom payment
Threatening to publish stolen data if ransom not paid
Impacted Systems: Victims of Sodinokibi/REvil and Maze ransomware
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection leading to data encryption and extortion
Indicators of Compromise: Holiday-themed ransom notes with messages such as 'Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays'
25% discount offer from Maze ransomware operators between December 25th and 31st
Discounted ransom demand of $500,000 for City of Pensacola by Maze operators
Threats to publish or delete victim data if ransom not paid
